Event 15 is the corrupted one. P493 passes from 43.2,34.0 to 108.2,39.6, about 65 m, with a duration of only 0.5 s. That is implausibly fast for a ground pass.

The end point also doesn't match the next event. The receipt by P245 (event 16) is at 53.7,39.6, so the true end x looks to have been altered.

This fits the fast_long_pass corruption type.

{"corrupt": "yes", "index": 15, "type": "fast_long_pass"}
